index_role: Additive prospective research-session index for this draft branch.
purpose: Make the published engineering change discoverable from AGENTS.md while preserving the prior canonical state and both source histories. This is index reconciliation, not executable branch integration.
session_rule: Read this index, the exact predecessor snapshot and applicable truth/protocol records before work. Append actual changes, verification and failures before finishing. Preserve negative, mixed, invalid and frozen evidence and its source identities.

predecessor_canonical_record.preservation: Entire original file retained byte for byte, including history, failures, test/source bindings, linked receipts and incomplete-import qualifications.
predecessor_canonical_record.path_resolution: Relative paths and source/test claims inside the snapshot refer to its immutable source commit, not to this draft branch.

separate_development_candidates.qualification: The source-bound record is indexed, but its separate implementation is not imported or claimed to have passed combined tests.

separate_development_candidates.scope: Opt-in alpha-aware paired planning and recomputed artifact admission; pinned v1 analysis, retained plans and negative studies remain unchanged.
separate_development_candidates.qualification: The retained verification applies only to the immutable implementation commit and the documented focused scope. No new test run is implied by this index update.

linked_development_receipts.scope: Opt-in alpha-aware paired planning and recomputed artifact admission; pinned v1 analysis, retained plans and negative studies remain unchanged.

verification.scope: 33 new generated-vector/actual-CLI cases and two retained planning tests; no model training.

linked_development_receipts.status: Published engineering candidate; draft and unmerged.
linked_development_receipts.scientific_disposition_change: None. The engineering result does not advance a scientific checkpoint, replace retained findings, or authorize a protected run.
linked_development_receipts.integration_state: The implementation is present in this draft branch. The separately indexed predecessor candidate has not been combined with it.

scientific_status.authority: Retained truth/protocol records and the source-bound predecessor snapshot remain authoritative. Separate candidates and their development checks do not establish empirical efficacy.
scientific_status.protected_execution: All existing evaluation holds, budget requirements and prospective protocol requirements remain binding.

index_reconciliation.action: Add AGENTS.md, this successor index, and the exact predecessor-state snapshot; preserve every pre-existing branch file.
index_reconciliation.verification: JSON parsing, predecessor and note Git-blob/SHA-256 bindings, copied instruction identity, explicit separate-candidate states, and complete remote-tree preservation.

history_index_coverage.scope: Exact predecessor record, its already-linked receipts, and the newly linked engineering candidate only.
history_index_coverage.limits: No complete repository-history audit or combination of separate implementations is claimed. Keep source identities when future authorized integration adds evidence.
